result.topic_en: Calculations on one-dimensional compressible gas flow (continuity and momentum equations via a potential, adiabatic pressure law), including a hodograph-type complex solution with a parameter λ, the case r = const, and an elementary maximization involving tangents of angles.
result.transcription:
$\int \varrho(dx - u\,dt) = \sigma$
$\varrho = \frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial x}\quad \varrho u = -\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial t}$
$\varrho u = m$
$\frac{\partial\varrho}{\partial t} = -\frac{\partial m}{\partial x}$
[-$\frac{\partial m}{\partial t} + \frac{\partial m}{\partial \varrho}$-]
[-$\frac{1}{\varrho}\frac{\partial m}{\partial t} + \frac{m}{\varrho^2}\frac{\partial m}{\partial x} - \frac{m}{\varrho}\frac{\partial \frac{m}{\varrho}}{\partial x}$-]
[-$\frac{\partial m}{\partial t}$-]
$\frac{\partial m}{\partial t} - u\frac{\partial\varrho}{\partial t} + u\frac{\partial m}{\partial x} - u^2\frac{\partial\varrho}{\partial x}$
$\frac{\partial m}{\partial t} + 2u\frac{\partial m}{\partial x} - u^2\frac{\partial\varrho}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}$
$\varrho^2\frac{\partial m}{\partial t} + 2m\varrho\frac{\partial m}{\partial x} - m^2\frac{\partial\varrho}{\partial x} + \varrho^2\frac{\partial p}{\partial x} = 0$
$\varrho = \frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial x}\quad m = -\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial t}$
$p = [-f(\sigma)-]\,\varphi\left(\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial x}\right)$
[-...-]
$\frac{2k}{k-1}\frac{p_1}{\varrho_1} + v_1^2 = v_1 v_2 \lambda\lambda = v\frac{2k}{k-1}\frac{p_2}{\varrho_2} + v_2^2$
$e^{4ri} = e^{2\sigma i}\frac{y+i}{y-i}\left(\frac{y-\lambda i}{y+\lambda i}\right)^\lambda\qquad y = \sqrt{\frac{\omega^2}{\varphi'(\varrho)} - 1}\qquad \omega^2 = aa\frac{1+yy}{\lambda\lambda+yy}\qquad \varphi'(\varrho) = \frac{aa}{\lambda\lambda+yy}$ [-$\omega^2 e^{2\sigma i} =$-]
$\frac{\partial w}{\partial s} = X(u+vy) + Y(v-uy)$
$2\frac{\partial w}{\partial s} = (X+Yi)\,\omega\, e^{-\sigma i}(1+yi) + (X-Yi)\,\omega\, e^{\sigma i}(1-yi)$
$r = \text{const}\quad \frac{\partial\varrho}{\partial s} = 0$
$e^{2\varrho i}e^{-2\sigma i}\frac{1+yi}{1-yi} = -1$
$e^{2\varrho i} = e^{2\sigma i}\frac{y+i}{y-i} = e^{4ri}\left(\frac{y+\lambda i}{y-\lambda i}\right)^\lambda$
$\frac{\lambda}{y} = \mathrm{tg}\frac{\varrho - 2r}{\lambda}$
$y = \lambda\cot\frac{\varrho-2r}{\lambda}$
$e^{2\sigma i} = \frac{y-i}{y+i}e^{2\varrho i} = \frac{1-\frac{1}{\lambda}\mathrm{tg}\frac{\varrho-2r}{\lambda}i}{1+\frac{1}{\lambda}\mathrm{tg}\frac{\varrho-2r}{\lambda}i}e^{2\varrho i}$
$\mathrm{tg}(\sigma-\varrho) = -\frac{1}{\lambda}\mathrm{tg}\frac{\varrho-2r}{\lambda}$
$\varphi'(\varrho) = \frac{a}{\lambda\lambda}\left(\sin\frac{\varrho-2r}{\lambda}\right)^2$
$\omega^2 = \frac{a}{\lambda\lambda}\left(\sin\frac{\varrho-2r}{\lambda}\right)^2\left(1+\lambda\lambda\left(\cot\frac{\varrho-2r}{\lambda}\right)^2\right)$
$e^{4ri} = e^{2\sigma i}\frac{1-yi}{1+yi}\left(\frac{\lambda+yi}{\lambda-yi}\right)^\lambda$
$e^{2\varrho i} = -e^{2\sigma i}\frac{1+yi}{1-yi} = -e^{4ri}\left(\frac{\lambda+yi}{\lambda-yi}\right)^\lambda$
$y = \lambda\,\mathrm{tg}\left(\frac{\varrho-2r+\frac{\pi}{2}}{\lambda}\right)$
$e^{2\sigma i} = -e^{2\varrho i}\frac{\lambda\,\mathrm{tg}\frac{\varrho-2r+\frac{\pi}{2}}{\lambda}+i}{\lambda\,\mathrm{tg}\frac{\varrho-2r+\frac{\pi}{2}}{\lambda}-i}$
$\cot(\sigma-\varrho) = \lambda\,\mathrm{tg}\left(\frac{\varrho-2r+\frac{\pi}{2}}{\lambda}\right)$
$\varphi'(\varrho) = \frac{aa}{\lambda\lambda}\left(\cos\frac{\varrho-2r+\frac{\pi}{2}}{\lambda}\right)^2$
$\omega^2 = \frac{aa}{\lambda\lambda}\left(\left(\cos\frac{\varrho-2r+\frac{\pi}{2}}{\lambda}\right)^2 + \lambda\lambda\left(\sin\frac{\varrho-2r+\frac{\pi}{2}}{\lambda}\right)^2\right)$
$2\int\varphi(\varrho)\,d\log\varrho + \omega^2 = (\lambda\lambda-1)\varphi'(\varrho) + \omega^2 = aa$
$e^{2\varrho i} = e^{2\sigma i}\frac{y+i}{y-i}\quad \omega^2 e^{2\sigma i} = (y+i)^2 e^{2\varrho i}\frac{aa}{\lambda\lambda+yy}$
$\omega e^{\sigma i} = (y+i)\,e^{\varrho i}\frac{a}{\sqrt{\lambda\lambda+yy}}$
$b\cos\psi = a\cos\varphi$
$\lambda\lambda b\sin\psi = a\sin\varphi$
$\mathrm{tg}\psi = \frac{1}{\lambda\lambda}\mathrm{tg}\varphi\quad \mathrm{tg}(\varphi-\psi) = \frac{\mathrm{tg}\varphi - \mathrm{tg}\psi}{1+\mathrm{tg}\varphi\,\mathrm{tg}\psi}$
$\frac{(\lambda\lambda-1)x}{1+\lambda\lambda xx} = \max.\quad \lambda x = 1$
$\mathrm{tg}\varphi = \lambda\quad \cos\varphi = \sqrt{\frac{1}{1+\lambda\lambda}}$
$\mathrm{tg}\psi = \frac{1}{\lambda}\quad \cos\psi = \sqrt{\frac{\lambda\lambda}{1+\lambda\lambda}}$
$\cos\psi = \lambda\cos\varphi = \sin\varphi$
$\lambda\sin\psi = \sin\varphi$
$aa = \lambda\lambda bb$
$\varphi'(\varrho) = bb\quad \frac{bb}{\varphi'(\varrho)} - 1 = 0$

Solution for r = const in trigonometric form
Resulting pressure-law derivative and ω² for r = const
